title: Everybody's in the Band — Nouns Drum Club

items.name: Everybody's in the Band
items.prompt:
Original iconic art-directed advertising key art for PointCast Nouns Drum Club. A joyful sculptural world of Nouns-inspired voxel characters with the instantly recognizable thick red adjoining square spectacle frames (Noggles). Tactile matte painted wood and clay, crisp blocky stepped silhouettes, sophisticated editorial still-life photography, hard directional studio sunlight, exquisite long shadows, very sparse premium composition, warm cream with signal orange/red and lilac. Accessible all-ages invitation to make music. Landscape 1536x1024. No text other than a single specified keyboard letter, no logos, no watermark, no NFT coins, no UI mockups. Subject fills central 65 percent with generous clean surround for responsive advertising layouts. High concept, witty, confident, physically believable materials. Make a finished advertising photograph, not a storyboard, collage, or contact sheet.

A gigantic warm ivory computer keycap marked with one black A has become a tiny bandstand. Four expressive Nouns-inspired block-sculpture musicians jam around and atop it: a sunny yellow sun-headed drummer, a turquoise cubic bird bass player, a lilac cloud-headed mallet player, and a tomato-red apple-headed keyboardist. All wear bold red square Noggles. Simple sculptural musical props, lively asymmetrical poses. Warm ivory seamless cyclorama, a vivid orange disc under the giant key. One strong iconic object/composition with lots of breathing room.
